build_package_protos: build grpc protobuf modules from proto files using the BuildPackageProtos setuptools command
run_preprocess: run the Preprocess command to copy channelz.proto and LICENSE files to the package directory
copy_channelz_proto: copy the channelz.proto file from the grpc proto directory to the grpc_channelz v1 package
copy_license: copy the LICENSE file from the repository root to the grpcio_channelz package directory
review_Preprocess_class: review the Preprocess setuptools Command class that copies proto and license files during build
